message.content:
C♯ major has **seven sharps** in its key signature:

| Note | Sharp |
|------|-------|
| F♯   | ✔ |
| C♯   | ✔ |
| G♯   | ✔ |
| D♯   | ✔ |
| A♯   | ✔ |
| E♯   | ✔ |
| B♯   | ✔ |

So the key signature for C♯ major is the same as that of the key with seven sharps.
